explanation: The person icon represents the speaker or a person.
The house icon represents home as a place.
The book icon represents a book or written material.
The food icon represents something to eat.
The cup icon represents something to drink.
The happy face represents a positive feeling.
The sad face represents a negative feeling.
The school building represents school as a place.
The phone icon represents the phone or calling device.
The bed icon represents a bed or resting place.
A person associated with liking or affection.
Food plus mouth represents moving food to the mouth.
Drink plus mouth represents drinking.
Movement directed toward home.
A book plus eye represents looking at written material.
A phone plus talk represents communicating by phone.
Question plus talk represents asking.
Ear plus talk represents receiving spoken language.
Movement directed toward school.
Bed plus sleep/rest mark represents sleeping.
A car plus movement represents driving.
Movement directed toward a medical place.
Person plus happy represents the speaker's positive state.
Person plus sad represents the speaker's negative state.
More modifies food to request an additional amount.

Person plus book plus eye represents the speaker reading.

Person plus want plus food represents a desire or request for food.
Person plus hospital plus movement represents going to a medical place.
